tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the VaneTools bilingual AI tools directory (~34k tools). Returns slug, name, one-line tagline, category, website and detail page URL.

tools.name: search_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search VaneTools' curated MCP (Model Context Protocol) server directory. Returns slug, name, one-line tagline, category, website and detail page URL.

tools.name: search_prompts
tools.description: Search the VaneTools curated prompt library (prompts for writing, coding, marketing and more). Returns slug, name, tagline, category and detail page URL.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the VaneTools Agent Skills directory (reusable skill packages for AI coding agents). Returns slug, name, tagline, category and detail page URL.

tools.name: search_plugins
tools.description: Search the VaneTools plugin directory (editor and agent plugins). Returns slug, name, tagline, category, website and detail page URL.

tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search VaneTools' AI learning resources (tutorials, guides, handbooks and courses). Returns slug, name, tagline, category and detail page URL.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get full structured details for one tool by slug: description sections, features, categories, website, pricing model and last-verified date. Use search_tools first to find the slug.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Get full structured details for one resource by type + slug. Works for all resource types: app, mcp, skill, prompt, plugin, learning, workflow. Use the search_* tools first to find the slug.
